metadata.description: Pradyut Kishore Manikya was the face of protest against CAA in Tripura. He resigned from Congress on this issue and formed Tipra Motha. Now  his party has joined BJP government in the state soon after signing a tripartite accord with Government of India and Tripura government. Since the Centre has now notified rules  for CAA paving the way for its implementation, Pradyut Kishore Manikya now faces a catch 22 situation in the state. We spoke to Jitendra Chaudhury, state secretary of CPIM on the this issue and the politics behind it.
